changes: Use the new manifest API from Fight Pass for everything (Faster and better VOD availability)
Fixed issues where some VODs were region-blocked and not allowed to download
Added support for re-downloading third-party media tools
Added support for exporting and importing the logged-in Fight Pass session
Added support for retaining the search query after starting a download. Users can now change the behavior in configuration
Saved credentials now correctly autofill in the Fight Pass login email and password inputs
Fixed an issue where the saved credential email appears in the search input
New changes in an update will now be shown in the update prompt
